title: Locked-camera 360 turntable
description: The camera is LOCKED and the subject rotates: a reference turntable, never a cinematic move. Never created by default; its cost is quoted first.

body.subject: Locked-camera turntable of {{subject}} from the reference image, kept in its pose throughout.
body.action: The subject rotates a smooth full 360 degrees around its own vertical axis over {{seconds}} seconds, starting facing the camera and rotating clockwise back to facing the camera at the end of the clip.
body.camera: The camera does NOT move: fixed at eye level on a tripod; no zoom, no dolly, no pan, no tilt, no shake.
body.style: White background pure throughout; neutral flat lighting, no rim light appearing, no shadow shifting; no motion blur; sharp focus across the rotation, identical to a 3D software preview render.
body.constraints: Pure rotation only: no pose or expression changes.

subject.description: the full character, or an accessory
